name: sod-policy-vector
description: The v0.9.0 review-workspace separation-of-duties clause (design §5/§6.5.5, contracts/approval.md): the decision is only legal when the authenticated reviewer's subject id DIFFERS from the pending revision's recordedBy (proposer). A non-empty proposer that equals the reviewer is a violation (fail-closed inside the transaction); an empty proposer (a source without an actor id) never equals an authenticated reviewer, so it can never be a self-decision. The SAME vector file runs from Go (authz.SODViolation) and TypeScript (authz/approval-policy.ts sodViolation) and must yield identical triples.
